configuration: verification/isomip/input.obcs laid over input: the same 50x100x30 spherical-polar ISOMIP cavity (0.3 deg x 0.1 deg, 30 levels of 30 m, eight 25x25 tiles, one process, bathy.box from input/) but with its own data file and a completely different numerical configuration from the other four isomip checks, namely a stratified initial column (Tref=-1.9 C everywhere, Sref rising from 34.4 to 35.27 over the lower twenty levels so that N^2=1e-5 s^-2), implicitDiffusion and implicitViscosity with no convective adjustment at all, the GGL90 turbulent-kinetic-energy closure (mxlMaxFlag=2, GGL90TKEsurfMin=1e-5 so that the ice-shelf bottom stress is felt in the TKE budget), the non-linear free surface in rStar form (nonlinFreeSurf=4, select_rStar=2, hFacInf=0.02, hFacSup=2.0, exactConserv) driven by a real fresh-water flux (useRealFreshWaterFlux), a prescribed open northern boundary (OB_Jnorth=50*-1 with useOBCSprescribe and no OB files, so T and S on the boundary fall back to tRef and sRef and the normal velocity to zero) whose volume and surface-flux imbalance is removed every step by useOBCSbalance with OBCSbalanceSurf and OBCS_balanceFacN=1, and pkg/shelfice in its full three-equation mode with velocity-dependent transfer coefficients (SHELFICEuseGammaFrict, SHELFICEconserve, SHELFICEboundaryLayer, SHELFICEadvDiffHeatFlux, SHELFICEselectDragQuadr=1) driving an ice shelf whose mass is stepped forward every time step from the prescribed tendency file iceShelf_MassTend.obcs (SHELFICEMassStepping with SHELFICEMassDynTendFile) over the truncated draft icetopo.obcs and the truncated load iceShelf_Mass.obcs; the graded window is 12 steps of 1800 s (21600 s, six hours, the deck's own 12 steps), which matches the window of the other four isomip checks and is long enough for the initial free-surface adjustment to the imperfectly balanced ice load to propagate to the open boundary and back while staying far inside the laminar, pointwise-reproducible regime (the deck's own monitor shows advcfl_uvel_max below 6e-4).. Graded: every <field>.<final iteration>.data written by the end-of-run state dump (the prognostic fields of write_state.F and of the packages in use), read with the shape and precision of the .meta sidecar; the initial-state dump and the log are not graded.
observable: every graded field of the final state dump after 12 steps (T and the other prognostic and package fields written at the final iteration), all cells
default_vs_upstream: nTimeSteps 12 (upstream 12); dumpFreq, pChkptFreq, chkptFreq 0 with dumpInitAndLast; writeBinaryPrec 64; useSingleCpuIO; SHELFICE_dumpFreq=1800. in data.shelfice, GGL90dumpFreq=1800. in data.ggl90, dumpAtLast=.TRUE. in data.diagnostics, fileName(1)='surfDiag' in data.diagnostics, fields(15,1)='SHI_mass' in data.diagnostics, frequency(1)=108000. in data.diagnostics, frequency(2)=108000. in data.diagnostics
variant: ic/variant is ic/nominal with shiCdrag=0.0015000000000000005 in data.shelfice instead of 0.0015, adding the line to SHELFICE_PARM01 (the deck leaves it at the package default 0.0015): two ulps of the graded precision (2.9e-16 relative) on a parameter that enters the tendency from the first step, verified to be a distinct double, so the two runs differ at round-off level without leaving the round-off floor; the recorded spread is the check's real sensitivity under this rule.
altbuild: the same pinned source built with genmake2 -ieee (gfortran -O0 -ffloat-store, strict IEEE arithmetic) instead of the optimised linux_amd64_gfortran optfile: a build a correct candidate could plausibly be, with no change of source or deck

comparison.files: every <field>.<iteration>.data at the final iteration of the reference, minus not_graded; the candidate must have the same set at the same iteration
comparison.format: raw big-endian IEEE floating point as written by pkg/mdsio (writeBinaryPrec=64), precision and dimensions from the .meta sidecar

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-05: run.sh altbuild (genmake2 -ieee: the same source at -O0 -ffloat-store, strict IEEE arithmetic, instead of the optimised optfile) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: all graded values within bound

faults.how: same optimised build and deck as the reference with one parameter changed, compared under the check's own rule (atol 1e-10, rtol 1e-08, the check's exclusions applied), natively on the x86_64 host on 2026-09-02

altbuild.what: genmake2 -ieee: the same source at -O0 -ffloat-store, strict IEEE arithmetic, instead of the optimised optfile

warrant: The observable is every cell of every prognostic field in the final state dump, compared as |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-08|r|; the relative part is the working bound because the graded fields span many orders of magnitude, the absolute part covers cells at or near zero. The observable is every cell of the final state dump (U, V, W, T, S, Eta, PH, PHL) together with the shelfice fluxes SHICE_fwFlux and SHICE_heatFlux, the GGL90 prognostic and derived fields GGL90TKE, GGL90viscArU, GGL90viscArV and GGL90diffKr, and the two diagnostics streams, compared as |c - r| <= atol + rtol|r|. The bound is physical because every distinctive ingredient of this deck is an algebraic or a directly solved relation with no tunable slack: the three-equation melt balance is a quadratic in the interface salinity whose coefficients are built from the transfer coefficients, the latent heat and the pressure-dependent freezing line, so any change to the friction law or to a coefficient moves the fresh-water flux by percents, not by round-off; the ice-mass update is a plain forward Euler step on a prescribed tendency, so a wrong factor is visible in SHI_mass and, through the load anomaly, in Eta at once; and the rStar free surface makes every grid-cell thickness a function of the surface elevation, so an error in the free-surface solve is amplified into every tracer and momentum tendency rather than confined to Eta. It is achievable because the only iterative object in the whole check is cg2d, which the upstream run shows converging in 208 to 211 iterations to a last residual near 1e-13, and because this deck, unlike the other four isomip decks, does not call convective adjustment at all: it starts from a stably stratified salinity profile (N^2 = 1e-5 s^-2 by construction in gendata.py) and mixes only through the implicit vertical diffusion and the GGL90 closure, so there is no neutral-density comparison to make the mixing branch degenerate to round-off and the floor of this check should be the tightest of the isomip family. ALLOW_SHELFICE_REMESHING is undefined in the default pkg/shelfice/SHELFICE_OPTIONS.h and the experiment supplies no override, so SHI_update_kTopC is forced to false and no cell ever opens or closes during the run, which removes the discrete-event hazard that the shelfice-remesh check has to live with. A reviewer must know two things: the open boundary is balanced by a global sum over the whole domain in pkg/obcs/obcs_balance_flow.F once per step, which is the one place where a change in summation order can inject a round-off perturbation into every boundary cell at once, and the non-linear free surface clips the rescaled thickness at hFacInf=0.02 and hFacSup=2.0, a threshold that the tiny surface excursions of this laminar 30-hour window should never approach but that must be confirmed in the measured spread. Faults: Dropping the logarithmic ustar dependence in the Holland and Jenkins transfer coefficient of pkg/shelfice/shelfice_thermodynamics.F, or replacing gammaTurb by the constant gammaTurbConst, changes shiTransCoeffT and shiTransCoeffS by tens of percent and moves SHIfwFlx, SHIhtFlx and the top-cell salinity by parts in 1e-1. Using the wrong two-thirds power in shiPr and shiSc, or dropping the molecular terms gammaTmoleT and gammaTmoleS, is a several-percent error in the same fields. Forgetting the deltaT factor or the sign in the mass update of pkg/shelfice/shelfice_step_icemass.F, or failing to rebuild shelficeLoadAnomaly from the new mass, changes the surface pressure load by order 1e-5 of the ice load per step, which appears in Eta, PH and PHL within a few steps and in SHI_mass immediately. Skipping the OBCSbalanceSurf contribution or the OBCS_balanceFacN weighting in pkg/obcs/obcs_balance_flow.F leaves a net volume source that drives Eta away by a measurable amount over the 12-step window. Replacing the rStar rescaling of the hFacs in model/src/update_r_star.F by the linear free-surface approximation, or dropping the exactConserv correction, moves the whole state by parts in 1e-4. On the mixing side, dropping the shear-production or the buoyancy term in pkg/ggl90/ggl90_calc.F changes GGL90TKE and GGL90diffKr by tens of percent, which reaches T and S in the first step through the implicit diffusion solve. A cheaper elliptic solve, for example relaxing cg2dTargetResidual from 1e-13 to 1e-9, moves Eta by parts in 1e-9 at once and by more after 12 steps, and carrying any of these fields in single precision shows up at parts in 1e-7. The expensive path under test is model/src/cg2d.F, which the upstream output shows taking 208 to 211 preconditioned conjugate-gradient iterations per step to drive the free-surface residual below cg2dTargetResidual=1e-13 and which therefore dominates the run; then the non-linear free-surface machinery that this deck alone exercises, model/src/calc_r_star.F, update_r_star.F and update_surf_dr.F rescaling every hFac each step, model/src/dynamics.F and thermodynamics.F with the implicit vertical viscosity and diffusion solves in solve_tridiagonal.F, pkg/ggl90/ggl90_calc.F, which builds and solves a tridiagonal system for the turbulent kinetic energy on every water column and then forms GGL90viscArU, GGL90viscArV and GGL90diffKr from the mixing length computed in ggl90_mixinglength.F, pkg/shelfice/shelfice_thermodynamics.F, whose gamma-friction branch (around line 463) forms ustar from shiCdragfld and the top-cell velocity and then the transfer coefficients from the Holland and Jenkins logarithmic law before solving the three-equation quadratic for the interface salinity, pkg/shelfice/shelfice_step_icemass.F, which advances shelficeMass by shelfIceMassDynTendency*deltaT and rebuilds the surface load anomaly, and pkg/obcs/obcs_balance_flow.F, which sums the normal flow and the surface fresh-water flux over the whole domain each step and corrects the boundary velocity.. The nominal-versus-variant spread recorded by selfcheck is the measurement of the round-off amplification under this exact rule, and the bound is finalised against it with the human.
